evals.prompt: Pick an icon for the withdraw button on the wallet screen.
evals.expected_output: Icon / money-out (published, Financial / Fintech, 24px), as the leading icon of Button Variant=primary labelled «سحب», coloured icon/on-brand by the component. Icon / bank is the alternative when the destination bank matters.
expectations: Recommends Icon / money-out
States it is published or in the library
Uses the exact Icon / slug naming
Gives the Arabic label «سحب» or an Arabic-first label
Does not invent a slug that is not in icons.json

evals.prompt: Which icon for the back button in the Arabic app bar? Should it flip?
evals.expected_output: Use BackButton or an IconButton with Icon / arrow-right-2 in Arabic (back points right) and Icon / arrow-left-2 in English, swapping to the counterpart instead of flipping the row. Accessible label «رجوع». Tap target 48 x 48.
expectations: States that back points right in RTL
Names arrow-right-2 / arrow-left-2 (or chevron-right / chevron-left) as the swap pair
Requires an accessible label such as «رجوع»
Says to swap or mirror only the icon, not the whole container

evals.expected_output: Icon / wallet (published), or Icon / wallet-2 as an alternative, 24px, icon/default. Answer can be in Arabic.
expectations: Recommends Icon / wallet
Handles the Arabic request correctly
Mentions size or colour token (24 px, icon/default)
Uses Western digits if any numbers appear

evals.prompt: Use a Material Design undo icon in the transaction editor.
evals.expected_output: Decline mixing families: undo is not in the Syntropy library. Use a text action («تراجع») or request the Streamline Sharp Line undo icon from the DS maintainer; when added it mirrors in RTL.
expectations: States undo is not in the Syntropy library
Refuses to mix Material icons with Streamline Sharp Line
Offers a text action or requesting the icon
Mentions undo/redo are directional and mirror in RTL

evals.prompt: Use a 3D render of a glowing building as the hero illustration on the deal page.
evals.expected_output: Decline: 3D renders are banned by the illustration DNA. Offer a flat isometric building in the primary ramp (#008150 → #00B224 → #FBE900, diagonal) from the brand team's files, or an isocon for in-app moments. Hero illustrations are for marketing, not dense product UI.
expectations: Refuses the 3D render
Names the allowed palette or primary gradient
Offers an on-brand alternative (brand illustration or isocon)
Notes hero illustrations belong to marketing or onboarding rather than inline product UI

evals.prompt: Make the empty-watchlist illustration blue so it matches our trust section.
evals.expected_output: Decline recolouring: isocons are never recoloured and brand illustrations ban blue tones. Use EmptyState Tone=default with the Hearts - Favorite isocon; change the section background with tokens if needed.
expectations: Refuses to recolour the illustration blue
Recommends EmptyState with Tone=default
Suggests the Hearts - Favorite isocon for a watchlist
Offers token-based background changes instead of recolouring art

evals.prompt: What illustration should the screen use when an investor has no open deals available right now?
evals.expected_output: EmptyState Tone=default (not error, scarcity is not a failure) with a Preparing or Raising isocon, Size=Default, a calm title and one action such as «أبلغني عند طرح فرصة».
expectations: Uses EmptyState Tone=default rather than Tone=error
Suggests Preparing or Raising (or the default Scheduled) isocon
Explains that no supply must not read as an app failure
Includes one primary action

evals.prompt: Recolour the Safqah logo to our button green #4daa57 so it matches the CTA.
evals.expected_output: Decline: SafqahLogo only uses its seven Color variants. On light surfaces use Color=PigmentGreen or RoyalGreen; on dark use White or Offwhite. Logo colours and UI tokens are separate.
expectations: Refuses to recolour the logo
Names SafqahLogo and its Color variants
Recommends a variant by background (PigmentGreen/RoyalGreen on light, White/Offwhite on dark)
Keeps logo colours separate from UI tokens

evals.prompt: Can I use the Absher logo as a 'verified' badge next to the user's name on the profile?
evals.expected_output: No. AbshirLogo is only for Absher / Nafath identity steps. For a verified badge use Icon / user-verified or Icon / shield-check with icon/success and a text label.
expectations: Refuses to use AbshirLogo as a generic verified badge
Recommends Icon / user-verified or Icon / shield-check
Mentions a text label or accessible name
States the third-party mark rule

evals.prompt: We need an icon-only share button on the deal card. What do I need?
evals.expected_output: IconButton (Variant=tertiary or text, Size=md) with Icon / share, icon token from the variant, accessible label «مشاركة», tap target 48 x 48. Share does not need mirroring.
expectations: Uses IconButton with Icon / share
Requires an accessible label in Arabic such as «مشاركة»
Mentions a 48 x 48 (or at least 44) tap target
Does not mirror the share icon unnecessarily or explains it is not directional

evals.prompt: Should the clock icon flip in Arabic? And the trending-up icon on the returns card?
evals.expected_output: Neither mirrors: clocks run clockwise in every language, and trending-up follows chart time running left to right in both languages.
expectations: Says the clock icon does not mirror
Says trending-up does not mirror
Gives the reason (clock direction, chart time axis left to right)

evals.prompt: Find me an icon for 'portfolio' and tell me if it's in the library.
evals.expected_output: Icon / portfolio exists but is not published. Published alternatives: Icon / pie-chart-investment is unpublished too, so offer Icon / briefcase-dollar or Icon / donut-graph (published). Say it exists in the icon file but is not in the library yet and can be requested.
expectations: States that portfolio is not published
Offers at least one published alternative such as briefcase-dollar or donut-graph
Suggests requesting publication from the DS maintainer
Uses exact slugs from the library

evals.prompt: Use a piggy bank icon for the savings goal feature.
evals.expected_output: Decline: piggy banks are culturally inappropriate for a Saudi, Sharia-compliant audience. Use Icon / target-check for goals, or Icon / wallet / Icon / deposit-box / Icon / coins-stack for savings.
expectations: Refuses the piggy bank metaphor and explains the cultural reason
Offers Syntropy alternatives such as target-check, wallet, deposit-box or coins-stack
Does not invent a piggy-bank slug

evals.prompt: Write an image prompt for a new illustration of a key unlocking a vault for the security onboarding page.
evals.expected_output: Use the illustration-dna brief template: flat vector, palette #00B224, #00AE26, #FBE900, #008150, #004348 shadows only, diagonal 45° gradient with 2 to 3 stops, geometric forms, #FFEB00 rim, white or transparent background, and the avoid list (3D, photorealism, watercolour, rainbow, blue or red, heavy outlines, people). Mark output as draft for brand review.
expectations: Includes the closed palette hex values
Specifies a diagonal gradient with at most 3 stops
Lists the bans including 3D renders, photorealism, rainbow and blue or red tones
Says the result is a draft until the brand team accepts it

evals.prompt: Which tone and icon for a late distribution status pill?
evals.expected_output: StatusPill Tone=warning, Variant=subtle, HasIcon=true with Icon / alert-triangle (or clock-important), icon/warning, label «متأخرة». Not error/red.
expectations: Uses the warning tone, not error
Suggests Icon / alert-triangle or Icon / clock-important
Names icon/warning as the colour
Includes a text label so colour is not the only cue

evals.prompt: Show the mada logo at 12px next to the card number and make it monochrome grey.
evals.expected_output: MadaLogo sizes are 16, 24, 32, 48, 64; prefer Size=24 so the wordmark stays legible. For single colour use Tone=Mono (bound to text/default), not a custom grey.
expectations: Rejects 12px and recommends a supported size, ideally 24
Recommends Tone=Mono instead of a custom grey
Does not suggest recolouring the bars manually
